one_liner: Grain (grain.com) has a documented REST public API with free-plan Personal Access Tokens, OAuth2 auth-code+PKCE, and an official remote MCP server.
auth_notes: Bearer tokens: PAT (free, all plans), WAT (Business/Enterprise, admin), and OAuth2 authorization code flow with PKCE for integrations distributed to any Grain user. Nango notes the API is in beta with limited developer access and a redirect URI must be registered, so OAuth app registration may need vendor contact.
access_notes: Personal API access is available on every plan including Free, so a builder can get working credentials self-serve. Workspace tokens need Business/Enterprise. A third-party page claims Business is required, but the official Grain support article contradicts it.
blocker_notes: PATs are free and self-serve, so testing can start now. Minor uncertainty: Nango says OAuth developer access is limited to select partners.

evidence.quote: The API supports a standard OAuth2 Authorization Code flow, including the PKCE extension for client-side only authentication.
